basel-esophagus.title: Human nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium
basel-esophagus.creator: University of Basel; individual photographer not separately named
basel-esophagus.matches: Human esophageal photographs show basal/intermediate layers and flattened, still-nucleated superficial cells without surface keratin.
basel-esophagus.viewLimitations: H&E child esophagus, not the idealized drawing's regular cells. Use the static photographs below the partially failing overview viewer.
basel-esophagus.reproductionRights: Source License section identifies University of Basel. No reproduction permission is asserted or exercised.

basel-esophagus.visualEvidence: Main agent inspected actual high-power photograph s2zv3t; browser also inspected 50uzjb, k6o3vz and 16t4o8. All four static micrographs loaded; superficial nuclei and epithelial layers were seen.

basel-skin.title: Human keratinized stratified squamous epithelium
basel-skin.creator: University of Basel; individual photographer not separately named
basel-skin.matches: Human finger-skin photographs show the layered epidermis, thick superficial keratin and epidermal/dermal boundary.
basel-skin.viewLimitations: Human thick finger skin, H&E; not proof of every specialized epidermal cell. Use the static photographs below the partially failing overview viewer.
basel-skin.reproductionRights: Source License section identifies University of Basel. No reproduction permission is asserted or exercised.

subject.en: Human keratinized epithelium; static photos below viewer
subject.es: Epitelio humano queratinizado; fotos estáticas bajo el visor

basel-skin.visualEvidence: Main agent inspected photograph 5x7nau; browser inspected vjjkqr and fsyvac. All three static photographs loaded. Epidermis and surface keratin were actually seen.

basel-trachea.title: Human pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium
basel-trachea.creator: University of Basel; individual photographer not separately named
basel-trachea.matches: Human tracheal micrographs show pseudostratification, cilia, goblet cells and the epithelial/connective-tissue interface.
basel-trachea.viewLimitations: Azan-stained trachea, not the schematic's evenly spaced cells. Use intact static fields below the partially failing overview viewer; damaged epithelium is separately labeled.
basel-trachea.reproductionRights: Source License section identifies University of Basel. No reproduction permission is asserted or exercised.

basel-trachea.visualEvidence: Main agent inspected gn0mtg, an actual high-power micrograph showing cilia, nuclei at different heights and goblet cells. Browser also inspected lri7r7 and wf0sqx; all four static images loaded.

adult-position.title: Adult human body, anterior and posterior anatomical position
adult-position.creator: City Studios, Stockholm; uploaded by Mikael Häggström; derivative assembly by Lamilli
adult-position.matches: Actual adult human photographs show upright anterior and posterior surface anatomy, arms slightly abducted and palms anterior.
adult-position.viewLimitations: Two adult models, hair removed and photographs retouched; not internal anatomy. Front views are above, back views below. The page separately warns about personality rights.
adult-position.reproductionRights: Commons states CC0 1.0 and a separate personality-rights warning; the caption records model consent for the stated publication. Only the original page is linked, with no reproduction.

subject.en: Adult surface anatomy; anterior photos above, posterior below
subject.es: Anatomía superficial adulta; fotos anteriores arriba y posteriores abajo

adult-position.visualEvidence: Main-agent public-page screenshot Human_Body_EMXj showed all four actual adult photographs; Human_XFVD separately showed the larger anterior photographs. Source caption explicitly identifies photographed adult humans.

mappings.reason: Actual photographed adult humans demonstrate anterior anatomical position. Different models, retouching and upper/lower source layout are disclosed.
Actual posterior photographs of the same standing adults demonstrate posterior anatomical position. The source's lower photographs, retouching and donor differences are disclosed.

Three separately inspected human specimens supply squamous, cuboidal and columnar epithelial forms and their tissue interfaces. Different sites/stains/donors and irregular cells are expected; routine light micrographs do not resolve basal-lamina ultrastructure.
